boxes.meaning: a pile or stack of flat things

english.note: Use this for a sheaf or stack of papers and similar flat items.
Use this for a pile made by placing relatively flat items or layers on top of one another.

examples.english: I put a sheaf of papers on your desk.
examples.traditional: 我執好一疊文件，擺喺你張枱面。

examples.english: I put a pile of documents on the desk.
examples.traditional: 我將一疊文件放咗喺枱面。
